task: Capture a stable DONE closeout snapshot for milestone-driven stories without weakening the live milestone_status freshness diagnostic.
outcome: After a milestone-driven story reaches DONE, the user can run a closeout command and see a table with every milestone, its final status, the solved problem, the acceptance rule, supporting evidence, risks, and next action, even if a later merge or version bump would make the live milestone_status diagnostic stale.
facts: B-7ba7 implemented milestone_status as a live read-only freshness report.
DONE merge/version commits can legitimately change material hashes after TEST evidence was accepted.
Users need a final closeout snapshot that represents accepted closure, not a recomputed live diagnostic.
The existing milestone status core already contains most row projection logic and should be reused.
constraints: Keep milestone_status live and read-only for active diagnostics.
Do not edit unrelated README drift.
Do not claim Authority or production DONE.
Do not rewrite the whole lifecycle; add a narrow snapshot path around DONE closure.
unknowns: Exact DONE code path where snapshot generation is least invasive.
Whether the user-facing surface should be a new command or a milestone_status mode.
